summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd (Nasdaq: BAOS) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications deficiency letter dated September 10, 2026, for failing the $1.00 minimum bid price standard under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) over the 30 consecutive business days from July 27 to September 9, 2026. The notice has no immediate delisting effect; the company has until March 9, 2027 (180 calendar days) to regain compliance, including by completing a reverse stock split at least ten business days before that date. A second 180-day period may be available subject to continued listing standards. Watch for split plans, bid-price recovery, and delisting risk.
